basic_idea: Model the outcome as a function of treatment and confounders.
main_strength: Simple and interpretable when the outcome model is credible.
main_failure_mode: Can be biased if the outcome model is misspecified.

basic_idea: Compare treated and untreated units with similar treatment probabilities.
main_failure_mode: Can be noisy or biased when matches are poor or overlap is weak.

basic_idea: Compare treated and untreated units within propensity-score strata.
main_failure_mode: Sensitive to bin choices and sparse cells.

basic_idea: Reweight units by inverse treatment probability to reduce observed confounding.
main_strength: Targets population-level effects directly when propensities are reliable.
main_failure_mode: Extreme weights can create high variance and fragile estimates.
